# fw permissions

> Reference of the fw permissions command: View or set agent permission mode. Usage, aliases and flags.

Source: https://docs.aphrody.com/cli/permissions/

View or set agent permission mode

## Usage

```bash
fw permissions [ask|auto|full-access]
```

## Subcommands

```bash
fw permissions ask
fw permissions auto
fw permissions full-access
```

The names come from the usage line.

Every command also accepts `-C`, `--directory`, `--offline`, `--json`, `-q` and `-v`. See the [overview](/cli/).
